name: com.delaruno20.ui-motion-toolkit
description: Timeline-authored animation for UI Toolkit. Author motions in the Timeline window (or from code), then play, reverse, toggle, show and hide them on any VisualElement by id - no PlayableDirector, no per-element components, unscaled time.

samples.description: A small menu: staggered entrance, hover/focus toggle, press pulse, show/hide panel. Pure USS art, no textures.
A full game-style screen: choreographed intro, boss bar hit reaction, tabs, popup, toasts, shake, loops and code-authored motions.
